बॉलीवुड़ गलियारों से आ गई है एकदम बड़ी और गरमा-गरम खबर! 🔥
फिल्मेकर राम गोपाल वर्मा पर लटक गई है कानूनी तलवार। 😱
प्रोडक्शन हाउस Eclatant Films Private Limited ने जारी किया है पब्लिक नोटिस।
मांगे गए हैं 29 करोड़ 67 लाख रुपये के बकाया पैसे। 💸
नोटिस के मुताबिक ये मामला जुड़ा है 10 अप्रैल 2010 के एक एग्रीमेंट से।
इसमें 11 करोड़ 38 लाख रुपये का ब्याज भी शामिल है। 📉
प्रोडक्शन हाउस का दावा है कि राम गोपाल वर्मा को बिना NOC लिए किसी से सौदा नहीं करना चाहिए।
अगर बिना NOC के काम किया तो कानूनी कार्रवाई की जाएगी। ⚖️
क्या राम गोपाल वर्मा इस मुसीबत से निकल पाएंगे? 🤔

ctx.text:
Filmmaker Ram Gopal Varma has found himself at the centre of a major financial dispute after Eclatant Films Private Limited issued a public notice demanding payment of Rs. 29.67 crores. The production house has also cautioned producers, distributors, broadcasters and streaming platforms against entering into transactions involving the filmmaker without obtaining its prior written approval, wherever required under their agreement.
The public notice, issued in 24th and 31st October 2026, issue of Atul Mohan's Complete Cinema magazine, states that Eclatant Films had issued a legal notice to Ram Gopal Varma on October 15, calling upon him to clear outstanding dues amounting to Rs. 29,67,64,000. Interestingly, the amount includes accumulated interest of Rs. 11,38,92,000.
According to the notice, the dispute stems from an agreement dated April 10, 2010. Eclatant Films has also referred to an order passed by the Bombay High Court on April 17, 2013, in connection with the agreement. The company has demanded that the filmmaker settle the outstanding amount by October 30, 2026. Failing this, it has warned that it would assert its contractual lien over RGV's share, rights, interests, revenues and exploitation rights in films and projects covered by the agreement.
Eclatant Films claims that its agreement requires Ram Gopal Varma to obtain a prior written No-Objection Certificate (NOC) before associating with third parties or undertaking activities involving film production, co-production, direction or writing until the outstanding dues are cleared.
The company has specifically cautioned individuals and entities proposing to acquire, license, distribute, broadcast, stream or otherwise exploit rights connected with projects falling within the scope of the agreement.
It has further warned that parties proceeding with such transactions without the requisite NOC would do so at their own risk. The notice mentions possible legal remedies, including injunctions, recovery proceedings and enforcement of contractual security rights.
